Vanessa Automation 1.2.043.28-itl-r13

This binary distribution is built from Pr-Mex/vanessa-automation
tag 1.2.043.28, commit f3a01778a14d29b38204685deea0131274d438ff,
with the source-controlled ITL MCP run-scenario and tool metadata compatibility
patch.

The upstream compatibility version remains 1.2.043.28. The downstream
revision itl-r13 identifies the patch and is not an upstream release.

Vanessa Automation is distributed under the BSD 3-Clause License. The
complete upstream copyright notice, license conditions, and disclaimer are
included in LICENSE at the root of the binary distribution.

The selected-feature tree keeps nested physical paths unchanged and resets
logical file levels after directory nodes are removed by FeaturesToRun.

Row-navigation criteria accept display captions independently of identifier rules.

The file-code protocol correction changes the bundled step library and VAExtension source.
The paired extension must be built and qualified before installation.

File-event monitors distinguish selected connections with missing or reused process IDs.
Durable pending-request state reconciles exact unfinished commands after a Vanessa restart.
